tools.name: replyToEmail

Expecting an answer? Pass await_reply: true to wait for it in this call. Result: the sent email's id, status, from, accep

tools.name: sendEmail

tools.name: listSentEmails
tools.description: List sent emails to audit delivery. Rows carry id, thread_id, created_at, status, from, to, subject and snippet, plus error_code, smtp_response_code or gates when a send did not deliver. Read one with getSentEmail. Result: sent_emails, cursor for the next page (null at the end), and total, total_cap

tools.name: getSentEmail
tools.description: Read a single sent email by id, to inspect its delivery, such as the SMTP response on a bounced send or the gate denial on a gate_denied one. Pass full: true for the stored record. Result: id, thread_id, created_at, status, from, to, subject, body_text and attachments; when set, scheduled_at, cancel

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getInboxStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Private data: getEmail, getSentEmail, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Public sink: getAccount, getInboxStatus, getOutboundStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, replyToEmail, sendEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, awaitReply, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Destructive: getEmailAttachment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getInboxStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Private data: getEmail, getSentEmail, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Public sink: getAccount, getInboxStatus, getOutboundStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, replyToEmail, sendEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, awaitReply, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Destructive: getEmailAttachment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
